notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.content:
Along with our friend Blinky, we want to announce a new update that will be reflected in the Steam demo. We have enhanced the experience by carefully adjusting the bars to move even more in sync with the music. This synchronization allows for greater immersion, making every moment in the game feel more rhythmic, more addictive, and even more challenging.

We continue working to release a game that exceeds your expectations!

Blinky and the Sureksu team
